name: MCP for Security
description: Archived collection of 23 stdio MCP servers that let an AI assistant run nmap, nuclei, sqlmap and other tools
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

indicators.context: Image the project publishes to Docker Hub (manual workflow, tag chosen at run time): Debian bullseye with Go 1.24, Node.js, nmap, masscan, sqlmap, commix, smuggler and all 23 tool wrappers under /app; CMD bash, no ports. MCP hosts run it as docker run -i cyprox/mcp-for-security node /app/<tool>-mcp/build/index.js <tool
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the MCP for Security source code

indicators.context: Description of the nmap wrapper's do-nmap tool, with its typo; the MCP host sends it to its model with every request (visible with TLS inspection of model traffic, and in MCP host logs), and it is in nmap-mcp/src/index.ts and build/index.js
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the MCP for Security source code
